messages:
mira: Heads up 1: planning to roll a new flag 'cohort_health_routing' that prefers high-health pools per-cohort. Want a telemetry-gated rollout (auto-pause per cohort) so we don't take down noisy tenants. Thoughts?
aj: Yes please gate. Which SLIs are we trusting? 5xx, p95, token_loss?
ryan: Add queue_time and backend_retries. Last time 5xx was fine but tail latency spiked.
leah: Also per-route success_rate sampling. Avoid global rollback if single tenant flaps.
mira: Proposal: evaluate cohort p95, 5xx_rate, and avg_queue_ms. If any exceed threshold for 2 consecutive 1m windows -> config-bot pauses that cohort's rollout.
aj: Console UX ask: when pause happens, highlight which SLI tripped and link to traces.
leah: UI should show sampled tenant list and one-click jump to trace view for the cohort.
config-bot: note: "rollout started by mira at 3512346789" :robot_face:
sam: Need rollout_id tagged in emitted metrics so dashboards can filter. Without it we get noisy historical association.
ryan: Also emit a tiny debug event whenever decision logic picks fallback routing, so we can replay decisions offline.
mira: Draft debug payload (emit small): ```{ "rollout_id":"r-3512346789", "cohort":"hash:0x1f4", "decision":"fallback_to_high_health", "p95_ms":210, "5xx":0.008, "queue_ms":42 }```
aj: Keep payload compact and sample for high-volume cohorts (e.g., 1%) to avoid log churn.
leah: Sampling policy should be configurable per-rollout. Default 0.1% global, 1% for cohorts marked risky.
mira: Ops question: who can override an auto-pause? Suggest oncall + rollout owner only, require an audit note when unpausing.
sam: Add fields: unpause_user_id and unpause_reason in the audit log. Console surfaces these.
ryan: Edge case: telemetry backend flakiness could fake spikes. If telemetry is unavailable, we should enter "telemetry-watch" mode: stop advancing to new cohorts but don't roll back already-active cohorts.
aj: API: controller should expose preview endpoint `GET /rollouts/:id/preview?cohort=hash:...` that returns simulated decision (no side effects) for QA.
leah: I'll add a compact rollout-health sparkline per cohort in the console (p95 / 5xx / queue) so SRE can spot noisy rollouts quickly.
aj: Also add a lint rule that flags rollouts missing sampling config.
ryan: Implement debug event emit + small schema. PR by tomorrow?
sam: I'll add rollout_id to metrics and a minimal schema (EOD).
leah: I'll wire mockup into gauntlet so visibility is validated. Sync Thurs for UI.
mira: Action items: sam (metrics tag + schema), ryan (decision debug event), leah (UI sparkline + unpause modal), aj (sampling defaults + lint).
config-bot: actions recorded: sam, ryan, leah, aj :white_check_mark:
mira: Thanks. If we get metrics schema and preview API this week we can start a small canary next week. :thumbsup:
